name: Abuse In A Marriage
overview: Scripture teaches that marriage is a sacred covenant in which husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:25). Abuse within marriage contradicts this call to kindness, tenderness, and forgiveness (Ephesians 4:32), and stirs up anger and strife rather than peace (Proverbs 15:1; 22:10). The Lord hates treacherous behavior and violence within the marriage relationship (Malachi 2:16), and the biblical teaching on divorce emphasizes faithfulness and the serious consequences of putting away a spouse except for fornication (Matthew 5:32). Thus, Scripture upholds the sanctity of marriage and condemns any form of abuse or betrayal within it.
